name: MasakhaNER 2.0: Africa-Centric Named Entity Recognition Benchmark
description: MasakhaNER 2.0 is a large-scale, high-quality human-annotated named entity recognition (NER) benchmark covering 20 diverse African languages spanning Southern, Western, Eastern, and Central Africa: Bambara (bam), Ghomala (bbj), Ewe (ewe), Fon (fon), Hausa (hau), Igbo (ibo), Kinyarwanda (kin), Luganda (lug), Luo (luo), Mossi (mos), Chichewa (nya), Nigerian Pidgin (pcm), Shona (sna), Swahili (swa), Setswana (tsn), Twi (twi), Wolof (wol), isiXhosa (xho), Yoruba (yor), and isiZulu (zul). The official Hugging Face dataset collection contains 152,786 sentences (106,964 train, 15,284 validation, 30,538 test examples) annotated for 4 entity categories: Personal name (PER), Location (LOC), Organization (ORG), and Date (DATE).
